## Problem Statement

Once session logs are parsed, the skill must extract repeated confusion patterns using deterministic heuristics — tool call distribution, thinking-content error signals, tool result errors, and retry/self-correction patterns. Raw logs are too large and noisy to send to an LLM directly.

## Goal

As a skill author, I want deterministic heuristic extraction of confusion signals from parsed sessions — counts, distributions, and capped excerpts — so the LLM classification stage receives compact, distilled input.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Tool call distribution: counts of each tool name across the 20 sessions, with per-tool error rates.
- [ ] Thinking-content error signals: detect keywords (`error`, `fail`, `retry`, `incorrect`, `sorry`, `wrong`, `fix`, `correct`, `issue`, `problem`, `confused`, `wait`, `actually`, `oh`, `hmm`, `ah`) in thinking content, with a context window around each hit.
- [ ] Tool result errors: detect tracebacks, `permission denied`, `command not found`, and shell expansion errors in `toolResult` content where `isError == true` or content text matches error patterns.
- [ ] Retry/self-correction patterns: detect repeated tool calls with identical arguments within a session, and detect sequences of (tool call → error result → modified tool call).
- [ ] False-positive mitigation: keyword matches are context-windowed; known legitimate uses (e.g. "error handling" in code text) are classified with surrounding context so the LLM can confirm.
- [ ] Per-session excerpt size is capped (configurable, default e.g. 2 KB/session) to bound the LLM prompt.
- [ ] Unit tests cover each signal type with synthetic session fixtures, including at least one borderline false-positive case.
- [ ] A `--max-sessions` and `--errors-only` CLI flag are exposed (or documented as function arguments) for deterministic testing.

## Constraints

- Deterministic and side-effect free: no LLM calls, no file writes.
- Configurable keyword lists (module-level constants) so tests and future tuning are easy.
- Excerpts must never exceed the configured cap.

## Key Files

- `skill/agent-log-review/scripts/agent_log_review.py` — heuristic extraction functions (`extract_tool_distribution`, `extract_thinking_signals`, `extract_tool_errors`, `extract_retry_patterns`)
- `skill/agent-log-review/tests/test_agent_log_review.py` — heuristic unit tests

## Dependencies

- Feature 1 (session log parser) — must be complete first.
